title: Tenma Saki — Hard-Knock Meeting〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm starving.
Wonder what they're gonna have at the school store today?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to find out♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, where should we have lunch today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's really nice out, so why not the courtyard?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm all for that♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay☆ I love having lunch out in the courtyard with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too!
And I hope that we all get to visit the same company together too♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
Do you think they'll tell us later today where we're going?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I sorta doubt it. We only got the details in homeroom yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the same time, the teacher did say most people will get their first choice as long as they don't do anything crazy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right...!
I really hope we can all go together.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe☆
They had some fun-looking rice balls today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I bought some too! The special plum flavor♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you're lucky, then you got one with two umeboshi in it, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I thought it'd be pretty obvious which ones had two in them, but I couldn't tell at all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They were all the same size, even, so they all looked the same.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But that turned it into a fun treasure hunt.
I tried so hard to make sure I got a lucky one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
Let's have these already and find out!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, okay.
Then, let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Mmm! So good!
I can see why these are so special♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure the taste is just your standard umeboshi rice ball, though.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, yes☆
My rice ball has two umeboshi in it♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm? So does mine...
Looks like we got lucky, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, you both got two?! No fair...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, lemme take a closer look...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm? Still nothing...
What if I took a bite from the other side?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you've taken a bunch of bites already...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: N-No, I'm sure I'll find it if I take a bite from this side!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, there's still a chance!
It might've found a good hiding spot on that side!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know you'll find it, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Emu!
Alright, I'm gonna find it no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nom! Nom...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, mine was the only one that wasn't special!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, your umeboshi must feel so lonely...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
What if this is foreshadowing something? Call it gut instinct...and not just because this is lunch!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does this mean I'm not gonna get my first choice for the program?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I seriously doubt that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I've got a really bad feeling about this!
I need to rack up some good deeds to counteract this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Rack up good deeds...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... Oh, in that case!
What if you helped out people in need?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
People in need...
Oh, I could lend them my textbooks and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess...
You could also let people copy your homework.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not so fast! This is about the math homework we were just assigned, huh? You want me to let you copy my answers!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's not what I said.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I also want the three of us to visit the same company together, Saki! So, I'll help you with whatever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Alright, we gotta perform as many good deeds as we can!
